text: Entry 487 enables experimental.mail.ews.enabled only inside both MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST and NIGHTLY_BUILD. The non-Nightly branch still disables it. These are build preprocessor conditions in a preference file, not ordinary JavaScript runtime branches. At the accepted endpoint, the literal preference occurs under mail/mailnews only in MailMigrator: profiles below UI version 56 clear a changed user preference because native EWS support no longer uses the gate. Preserve that migration boundary when reviewing an old default or a later setup path. This does not establish current EWS server behavior, server support, build results or runtime coverage. Complete owning discussion records acceptance and later reported beta test failures from the omitted non-Nightly semicolon, followed by a semicolon repair. The follow-up review and test logs were not read; no failure was reproduced.
title: Keep the old EWS preference gate separate from current migration cleanup
